text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Here we are, at the Yasuda Kinen. This is
where
this spring's King of the Mile is
crowned.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
The longest stretch in Tokyo... I'm sure
everyone'll
be givin' their all.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
But that's just gonna make winnin' even
sweeter!
Like comin' in from the side and
takin' out a
bunch of souped-up monster
trucks with the best
engines!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't get better than that! Right,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Course I can, assumin' the footwork we
worked on
is the real deal.
choice_data_list_en: Yeah, think you can do it?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'll accelerate like I'm glidin' over the
track and
reach top speed in a second!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Long as I nail that, I'm dead sure I can
win it—no
matter who I'm up against!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
This is where the new me is gonna be
born!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
That's right. Gettin' worked up like this
all by
myself is kinda lame.
choice_data_list: よし、ファンを湧かせてやれ！
うん、ファンを湧かせてあげて！
choice_data_list_en: Alright, go drive the crowd wild!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
The stands are packed, so I've gotta get
each and
every fan worked up with my
new weapon!
